liz: Heads-up: we're starting enrollment for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings for the 'Private' SKU. Main open items: GCP service-account permissions for KMS access, Azure publisher enrollment steps, and a lightweight manifest we can validate against each cloud. Can ops/legal/sales confirm owners?

omar: Ops here. I'll own the GCP service-account doc and the testing playbook. For BYOK on GCP we need the customer to grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to a service account we specify, or to the marketplace service identity. Example IAM binding: 

```
# grant binding to our marketplace SA
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/REDACTED/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/key --member=serviceAccount:redwood-marketplace@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

omar: Also for Azure BYOK we recommend customers add a Key Vault access policy that allows `wrapKey`/`unwrapKey` to the publisher service principal. I'll draft a snippet.

claire: Product: SKU naming suggestion is slightly different from hosted offerings to emphasize "Private": `redwood-private-core`, `redwood-private-scale`. Trials: GCP marketplace -> 30 credits mapped to ~100k tokens; Azure -> trial via CSP/MPN flow (sales-assisted). Need short marketing blurb (100-140 chars) and three bullets. I'll prepare copy.

vikram: Sales note: Azure publisher enrollment often stalls on MPN verification and tax form. Put a checklist in the docs: MPN ID, publisher profile screenshot, signed marketplace reseller agreement. I'll coordinate with our channel partners team.

tom: Legal: I'll prepare required marketplace SOW language and a minimal EU data residency clause. Also confirm refund policy for trial credits. Quick ask: are we accepting customer-managed keys in the listing or only as an enterprise option? That affects the indemnity language.

claire: We want to support BYOK as a first-class option in marketplace since many customers require BYOK for Private. Default will be Redwood-managed key unless customer selects BYOK during provisioning.

omar: Draft manifest sample for validation (I'll include minimal required fields):

```
name: redwood-private-core
version: 1.0.0
publisher: Redwood Inc.
sku: redwood_private_core
regions: [us-east-1, europe-west1, eastus]
kms_support: [rdw-managed, customer-byok]
trial: 30_credits
assets:
  - logo: s3://marketplace-uploads/private/logo-1024.png
  - hero: s3://marketplace-uploads/private/hero-1600x600.jpg
```

omar: I'll wire up a small validator script and run it against uploaded manifests. Ops will own the validator and basic schema.

liz: Integration test plan: 1) Upload assets to the marketplace bucket; 2) run manifest validator; 3) perform end-to-end provisioning with a test customer (Redwood QA org) using BYOK on GCP; 4) verify usage metering and billing events; 5) publish to staging storefront. Assign people?

omar: I'll take steps 2-4 with QA.

claire: I'll handle assets and short copy, upload by next Tue.

vikram: I'll prepare the Azure enrollment checklist and pre-fill tax/MPN steps for the first customers.

tom: I'll review the copy and draft clauses; expect legal pack Wed afternoon.

mkp-bot: Ticket MKP-777 created: `marketplace-private-manifest-validator` assigned to ops/product/legal. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MKP-777

liz: Recap/action owners: Omar (GCP/Validator & TF snippets) EOD Fri, Claire (SKU/copy/assets) Tue, Tom (legal clause pack) Wed, Vikram (Azure publisher/MPN checklist) Tue. I'll set a 30-min sync Fri 9:30 PT. :calendar:
